opcodes.name: NOP
opcodes.effect: No state mutation beyond lineage and successor selection.

opcodes.name: SET
opcodes.effect: Set one State64 field selected by flags[3:0] to arg0.

opcodes.name: JIT1
opcodes.effect: Derive a deterministic parity bit and add +/-arg0 to the selected field.

opcodes.name: KIN2
opcodes.effect: Apply integer second-order update v'=v+args; q'=q+v'.

opcodes.name: PHI
opcodes.effect: Advance lower-case phi modulo 2^12 and expose wrap/half-circle branch.

opcodes.name: TIME
opcodes.effect: Advance zero-based modular tick modulo 2^14 and fold winding into lineage.

opcodes.name: SDF0
opcodes.effect: Return literal zero relation for the current defined LUT cell.

opcodes.name: CONE
opcodes.effect: Evaluate a quantized log-polar cone/support relation.

opcodes.name: SPHERE
opcodes.effect: Evaluate a quantized radial/phi shell relation.

opcodes.name: KLEIN
opcodes.effect: Apply reflective Klein or source half-turn radial wrap.

opcodes.name: RADIX
opcodes.effect: Select one bit of the canonical 64-bit key.

opcodes.name: HINGE
opcodes.effect: Apply map1 deltas and optional orientation/sheet flips when branch=1.

opcodes.name: LSYS
opcodes.effect: Apply chirality-signed lower-case-phi turn and dyadic velocity scaling.

opcodes.name: PROJECT
opcodes.effect: Set a symbolic downstream output token without halting.

opcodes.name: EMIT
opcodes.effect: Set output token and emitted status; flag bit 0 may terminate the program.
